purpose: Track preservation and qualification of every pre-1.5 routerd 1.0 function, including non-resource surfaces. This static design ledger is not a product registry, a release result or proof of functional parity.

verdict_rules.unknown: No complete baseline parity or platform qualification verdict has been established. A partial pass or inventory presence must not become a full-feature pass.
verdict_rules.pass: Only for a specific executed check at its recorded source, environment, peer and configuration; does not propagate to sibling resource kinds or later revisions.
verdict_rules.fail: An observed violation; classify using the existing release policy instead of automatically excluding it as an environment problem.

evidence_levels.code-passed: Compiled or executed local code checks; skip and compile-only remain explicit.
evidence_levels.actual-controller: Production caller/controller/process behavior with the stated boundaries.
evidence_levels.native-kernel: Real kernel/service effects on the stated isolated target.
evidence_levels.independent-peer: Actual exchange/traffic with a distinct peer/client implementation as described by the evidence.

verdict_rules.unsupported: Do not assign without baseline/current implementation and target-platform evidence. Unobserved OS behavior remains unknown.
verdict_rules.revision_binding: Evidence is historical and scoped to its revision. Apply/change review and relevant retesting are required before carrying a result to the inventory snapshot or a later revision.
verdict_rules.completion: A main-router trial is intermediate. Every baseline function, command/UI/platform/distribution surface and required failure/recovery path must remain covered; unknown rows prevent a whole-task completion claim.

coverage.inventory_limit: 87 registered kinds and 90 tracked example artifacts are coverage checks, not the complete function definition and not qualification. The 90 artifacts include 63 YAML files plus documentation, scripts, provider implementations/tests and a NixOS example.
coverage.body_review_limit: Body/entry-point files and related tests are verified path mappings, not a claim that every body, caller or option has completed semantic parity review.

resource_inventory_source.kind_inventory: Every baseline kind occurs exactly once in features[].baseline_resource_kinds; registration presence alone has no qualification verdict.

coverage.example_inventory_rule: examples[] is the exact set of 90 baseline tracked paths. Presence is verified at the pinned current revision; complete semantic/example execution is unknown. Only declared-kind changes are listed separately.
